quadrature.source: Frozen P1-F and P1-G quadrature archives

recovery.field: report independently; not a density gate
recovery.local_meaning: if initialKL<10*floor, stability-only; otherwise require >=90% initial excess-KL reduction plus absolute success for local recovery, report final stability separately

definitions.teacher_scale: area-weighted teacher q RMS and (b-beta) Euclidean field RMS on same grid
definitions.collapse: q RMS<=max(1e-12,1e-8*teacher qRMS) AND field contributionRMS<=analogous floor AND max|q|<=10*q floor; global-family degeneration, not necessarily optimal global beta
definitions.mild: 0<q ratio<=.8, not collapsed, acceptable density recovery
definitions.severe: q ratio<=.5, not collapsed, KL>=degradation threshold
definitions.stable: all9 final monitor observations meet relevant threshold; q ratio range<=.1 and KL range<=.05*delta_global
definitions.post_growth: report separately whether q ratio ever exceeded .01 before nearzero/collapse; low initial branch is not newly induced collapse

pretraining_gates.policy: Any failed pretraining gate: zero updates, no repair/resampling/threshold relaxation

endpoint_gates.legacy: audit only; do not include legacy endpoint in fresh AND-gate
endpoint_gates.reason: The old empirical endpoint is not used in population target, initial state, controls or objective. Dependency scope changes by user request; numerical thresholds remain unchanged; P1-E gate/result immutable.
endpoint_gates.controls: global unpenalized and ridge; fixed-h unpenalized and ridge, recomputed on48/96/192
endpoint_gates.endpoint_policy: check each new endpoint; retain failed endpoint as grid_unresolved, no dose if any main endpoint fails; no legacy veto

endpoint_policy: No adaptive refinement/retraining if384/768 fidelity fails; mark unresolved. NaN aborts further training. No best checkpoint selection.

logging.every_step: 96 objective/gradients;48 recovery diagnostics; previous96 gradient dot actual update, actual96 loss delta, remainder

dynamics.gradient_spike: after25: grad/256>10 OR grad>10*median(previous25) with >1 absolute increase
dynamics.transition_candidate: after25: abs(delta qratio)>.1 OR abs(delta fieldratio)>.1 OR collapse indicator change; not a proven basin transition
dynamics.relative_update: actual L2 update / max(previous parameter L2,1e-30)
dynamics.objective_conflict: delta total<-1e-8 AND delta empirical>1e-8 AND delta KL>1e-8 AND delta centered_g_area_RMSE>1e-8; step48 and monitor96 separately
dynamics.coarse_conflict: also test fixed checkpoint intervals: every monitored total decreases, net empirical/KL96/g96 increase
dynamics.overfit: total and empirical decrease while independent KL96 and g96 error increase

interpretation: P1-F collapse indicator retained; joint functional failure additionally requires density and predictor failure. Cases A-F are not exhaustive or mutually exclusive. No collapse != recovery. Interaction=(empirical_lambda-empirical_0)-(population_lambda-population_0); one dataset/init, no significance claim. No positive bias amplification claim without positive empirical degradation contrast.
scope: Exactly2 new trajectories of2000 updates. No optimizer/lr/model/seed changes. Exactly one candidate full displacement on each new endpoint temporary copy; not a2001st training update.
publication: commit complete evidence and ordinary push codex-refactor after verification
comparison: Only training quadrature changes relative to P1-G; all4 fixed step2000 endpoints evaluated on384/768. Monitor96 common across old/new but is training grid for new; monitor192 independent for new.

linear_diagnostic.scope: Available for new runs only; cannot compare historical per-step reversal rates without archived full gradients.

endpoint_diagnostics.gradient: Exact two-pass streaming, primary512/check1024, direct96 and independent beta/u verification
endpoint_diagnostics.candidate: Reconstruct Adam next moment from step2000 state and total gradient96; no optimizer.step; one temporary theta+d each. Scalar formula independently verified.
endpoint_diagnostics.probe: alpha0 and1 only, data/penalty/total96 and384, no recovery claims from probe objective
endpoint_diagnostics.caution: 384 derivative convergence not established; finite-step comparison not causal attribution to penalty or universal optimizer failure.
